justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/file/CountingPathVisitor.java (325 lines) and src/test/java/org/apache/commons/io/file/CountingPathVisitorTest.java (89 lines). The class is centered on one concern: counting file, directory, and byte visits, with only a small set of fields (`PathCounters`, file/directory filters, transformer) and a narrow set of methods for builder setup, visit callbacks, and counter updates. The related subclasses `AccumulatorPathVisitor` and `CleaningPathVisitor` show that other behaviors have already been split out rather than left inside this class. The dedicated test file exercises only counting behavior and `toString`, which supports a cohesive, not overgrown, design.
